blocks.content: Before you code, let's think about how score tracking works in games.

items: A variable to store the current score (starts at 0)
A display on the screen to show the score to the player
Logic that increases the score when a mole is clicked
Update code that changes the display when the score changes
Your code increases the score variable by 1
Your code updates the screen to show the new score

blocks.content: This is a common pattern in game development—store data in variables, respond to events, update the display.
